steps.label: initial-import

expectations.uneven_epochs: gap seconds [30,30,60,30,60,30,30] are recorded, no equal-spacing assumption
expectations.missing_frequency: G02 L2 absent at epoch idx=4 -> band gap, split L2 arc
expectations.receiver_clock_jump: common step ~299792.458 m code / integer cycles phase at idx=5, scope=receiver, not a satellite slip
expectations.single_sat_slip: G03 idx=6 integer pair (2,1) baseline -> (3,2) after local amendment
expectations.lli_false_positive: G02 idx=7 LLI bit set with no phase step -> candidate rejected
expectations.multiple_tied_offsets: G02 idx=6 GF lattice contains both (1,0) and (0,-1), MW=1, TD unavailable -> ambiguous
expectations.arc_local_expiry: G03 amendment expires only G03 arcs/residuals/candidates; G01/G02/R07 stay current
